description: ML anomaly incident triggered by latency spike

questions.text: Why did the anomaly detector flag this incident?
Which signals or features changed the most?
Could this be a false alarm?
What was the observed P95 latency compared to the baseline?
Did request rates or traffic drop during the latency increase?
What should I check first to mitigate this?
How long did it take for the anomaly score to cross the threshold?
Are there any database connection or 5xx errors recorded?

description: ML anomaly incident triggered by CPU stress

questions.text: Why was this CPU anomaly flagged?
What was the mean CPU percentage observed at detection time?
Did CPU variance (standard deviation) increase?
Did higher CPU cause higher response latencies?
Which container or service consumed the high CPU?
Is this CPU load within expected normal baseline behavior?
What investigation command should I run on the host?
Did the incident resolve automatically?

description: Rule Guard incident (container crash or rapid error rate)

questions.text: What rule triggered this incident?
Which container died or crashed?
Was an exit code or die event recorded by Docker?
Did the container restart automatically?
What errors were logged by the service right before it stopped?
Were downstream services affected by this container going down?
How does this rule guard differ from the ML anomaly detector?
What manual steps are needed to verify service health?
